introduction_raw:
Jump starting is a way to start a car with a dead battery by using another vehicle's battery to provide power. This is done by connecting the dead battery to the other vehicle's battery using jumper cables. The other vehicle's battery provides power to the dead battery, allowing the car to start.

[br]


== Jump starting electric cars ==
Electric vehicles are also equipped with a 12-volt starter battery to activate the high-voltage system. Empty or defective starter batteries are therefore also possible in this vehicle category. The jump start basically works the same as with any petrol or diesel engine.

Jump starting is generally allowed for electric cars, but using them to jump start another car is usually not permitted by the manufacturer. Electric vehicles are normally equipped with smaller starter batteries. For this reason, in the worst case, an electric car that provides power for a jump start could damage the donor battery or the on-board electrical systems.

[br]


== Warning ==
***It is important to follow the proper procedure when jump starting a car to avoid damaging the vehicles or causing harm to yourself.***

lines.text_raw: Is the broken-down vehicle parked on a busy road or in a blind spot? Then set up a [guide|156139|warning triangle and put on a safety vest] before you start working on the vehicles.
lines.text_rendered: Is the broken-down vehicle parked on a busy road or in a blind spot? Then set up a warning triangle and put on a safety vest before you start working on the vehicles.

lines.text_raw: Pull the hood release lever. It's usually located inside the car, near the steering column.
lines.text_rendered: Pull the hood release lever. It's usually located inside the car, near the steering column.

lines.text_raw: If you can't find the release lever in your car, it might help to consult the car's owner's manual.
lines.text_rendered: If you can't find the release lever in your car, it might help to consult the car's owner's manual.

lines.text_raw: Raise the hood by simultaneously lifting and pressing the hood latch release. It is usually a paddle located beneath the front edge of the hood, near the center or center-right.
lines.text_rendered: Raise the hood by simultaneously lifting and pressing the hood latch release. It is usually a paddle located beneath the front edge of the hood, near the center or center-right.

lines.text_raw: At this point, depending on the vehicle, your hood may raise and support itself automatically, if not, use one hand to hold the hood open temporarily while securing the hood with the prop rod.
lines.text_rendered: At this point, depending on the vehicle, your hood may raise and support itself automatically, if not, use one hand to hold the hood open temporarily while securing the hood with the prop rod.

lines.text_raw: Lift one end of the prop rod up or out to release it from the front area of the engine bay.
lines.text_rendered: Lift one end of the prop rod up or out to release it from the front area of the engine bay.

lines.text_raw: Swing the end of the prop rod up and slide it into the corresponding cutout on the underside of the hood.
lines.text_rendered: Swing the end of the prop rod up and slide it into the corresponding cutout on the underside of the hood.

lines.text_raw: Make sure the hood is well secured before you let go with your other hand, or it may fall and injure you.
lines.text_rendered: Make sure the hood is well secured before you let go with your other hand, or it may fall and injure you.

lines.text_raw: Locate the battery on both cars.
lines.text_rendered: Locate the battery on both cars.

lines.text_raw: The battery might be hidden under a cover. Usually, you can just look for a car battery-sized plastic cover with a battery pictogram on it.
lines.text_rendered: The battery might be hidden under a cover. Usually, you can just look for a car battery-sized plastic cover with a battery pictogram on it.

lines.text_raw: Connect the red wire to the + lead of the battery in the donor car.
lines.text_rendered: Connect the red wire to the + lead of the battery in the donor car.

lines.text_raw: Then connect the other end of the red wire to the + lead of the dead battery.
lines.text_rendered: Then connect the other end of the red wire to the + lead of the dead battery.

lines.text_raw: The + lead is typically covered by a plastic cover. If both leads are covered the + lead is usually red.
lines.text_rendered: The + lead is typically covered by a plastic cover. If both leads are covered the + lead is usually red.

lines.text_raw: If you mix up the + and - poles when starting the vehicle, you risk expensive damage to the vehicle's electrical system.
lines.text_rendered: If you mix up the + and - poles when starting the vehicle, you risk expensive damage to the vehicle's electrical system.

lines.text_raw: Connect the black wire to the - lead on the donor cars battery.
lines.text_rendered: Connect the black wire to the - lead on the donor cars battery.

lines.text_raw: Connect the other end of the black wire to the ground connection/ground point or a metal part of the motor block of the broken-down car.
lines.text_rendered: Connect the other end of the black wire to the ground connection/ground point or a metal part of the motor block of the broken-down car.

lines.text_raw: You can typically find the ground connection/ground point written in your car’s manual.
lines.text_rendered: You can typically find the ground connection/ground point written in your car’s manual.

lines.text_raw: Do not connect the black wire directly to the - terminal of the dead battery. Doing so may create sparks near the battery, potentially causing an explosion.
lines.text_rendered: Do not connect the black wire directly to the - terminal of the dead battery. Doing so may create sparks near the battery, potentially causing an explosion.

steps.title: Start the motor of the donor car

lines.text_raw: Start the motor of the donor car.
lines.text_rendered: Start the motor of the donor car.

steps.title: Try to start the broken-down car

lines.text_raw: After a couple of minutes, try to start the broken-down car.
lines.text_rendered: After a couple of minutes, try to start the broken-down car.

lines.text_raw: If it doesn’t work, try again a minute later.
lines.text_rendered: If it doesn’t work, try again a minute later.

lines.text_raw: After the third unsuccessful attempt to start the car, further attempts may cause damage. Consider seeking professional assistance.
lines.text_rendered: After the third unsuccessful attempt to start the car, further attempts may cause damage. Consider seeking professional assistance.

lines.text_raw: If the broken-down car has succeeded in starting, let both vehicles run for a few more minutes.
lines.text_rendered: If the broken-down car has succeeded in starting, let both vehicles run for a few more minutes.

steps.title: Switch on power consuming electronics in the broken-down car

lines.text_raw: When the engine is running in the recipient car, switch on larger, power hungry electric loads, such as the AC, radio and lights to avoid voltage peaks and thus protect the on-board electronics.
lines.text_rendered: When the engine is running in the recipient car, switch on larger, power hungry electric loads, such as the AC, radio and lights to avoid voltage peaks and thus protect the on-board electronics.

lines.text_raw: First disconnect the black wire from the donor car, then from the broken-down car.
lines.text_rendered: First disconnect the black wire from the donor car, then from the broken-down car.

lines.text_raw: Remove the red wire last.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the red wire last.

lines.text_raw: Keep the broken-down car’s engine running and switch off the unneeded electronics again.
lines.text_rendered: Keep the broken-down car’s engine running and switch off the unneeded electronics again.

lines.text_raw: Watch out for any warning lights on the dash and call a professional if any problems occur.
lines.text_rendered: Watch out for any warning lights on the dash and call a professional if any problems occur.

lines.text_raw: In the event of problems occurring, the electrical support for driving functions such as power steering can fail.
lines.text_rendered: In the event of problems occurring, the electrical support for driving functions such as power steering can fail.

comments.title: How jump start a Car or Truck
comments.text_raw: After closing the hood be sure to drive at least 10-15m to charge the battery of the car which needed the jump start. 10-15m of normal driving should fully charge the battery and be able operate as usual. If restarting isn’t possible after 10-15m of normal operation (not just idling) the battery and/or charging system should be inspected by a professional.
